purpose: Understand the repo at a glance
powers: README, file tree, latest commit and branch count. Code menu contains Run on a sandbox. Product .smithers/home.json blocks appear ABOVE the file table in this order: text, prompt, links, Fixed by agents, then member-only S.Home.App blocks; then Files; then README. Hide App blocks from signed-out visitors and nonmembers. Repos without blocks keep GitHub’s layout. The right sidebar holds Releases ONLY (PM d-59r9fj). The repo-header chip is the one sync surface on every view: Synced with GitHub, stale with its age, or failed with the reason, never a bare green Synced; members open Settings → GitHub sync from it, readers and signed-out visitors see plain text, not a link.
anatomy: Repository header, branch picker and file table with last commit per row, README below, only Releases in the right sidebar; GitHub sync state in the repo-header chip. Tabs in order: Code, Issues, Pull requests, Runs, Flows, Wiki, declared tabs, Settings (members only). At most three declared tabs, configured by the repo; no Stack, Agents, Approvals or Releases top-level tab.

powers: Code intelligence: hover, definition, diagnostics through code.* flows; Ask about this file; line selection to ask or make a TODO. The blob shows the whole file up to and including 512 KiB; larger files show size and a raw link instead of partial source. The 16 KiB CARD_CONTENT_CAP is only for embedded chat file cards.
anatomy: Branch picker, path breadcrumbs, directory rows with last commit, file toolbar, complete source with line numbers and selectable lines; directory and file are separate subjects. A blob must not truncate a file at 16 KiB; assess full-file evidence, not a truncated judge excerpt.

purpose: Who changed each line and why
powers: Agent-authored lines marked by the commit's agent trailer; the mark links the originating run.
anatomy: File breadcrumbs, line numbers and source aligned with grouped author, commit and date attribution; commit links beside the attributed ranges.

powers: Agent commits marked; each links its run when the trailer carries one.
anatomy: Branch selector and chronological commit list grouped by date, commit message, author, time and short SHA; pagination where needed.

purpose: One change, its diff and checks
powers: Linked run, review receipt, landing. A person reviews and merges.
anatomy: Commit title, author, SHA and parents, checks, file change counts and per-file unified diffs with line anchors; browse files at this immutable revision.

powers: Each branch's sandbox state (running, suspended), its run, Fork/Rebase/Archive through branch.*, Run on a sandbox through box.open.
anatomy: Default branch, active and stale branch lists, last commit, comparison information and a branch search; branch controls stay beside their branch.

powers: Make TODO / Implement (issue.implement) and Reproduce (issue.repro) on the issue; saved view Fixed by agents with the evidence strip. Missing input opens a form card. GitHub /labels and /milestones paths redirect to /issues.
anatomy: Open/closed toggle, filters, labels and issue rows; detail has issue title and number, author, timeline/comments and right sidebar for labels and assignees.

primary: Open the next one to review
powers: Landing requests for native repos in the same list; agent PRs show their run and review receipt. Stack beside Pull requests: the team's ordered work with answer, merge, reorder, retry. A person reviews and merges; hosted merge has an install-only state when held. The Stack is the canonical TODO list, so Add TODO is correct. A repo may rename it; only Smithers calls its Stack Landing queue and hides Add TODO. No agent approves, gives a merge verdict, merges or lands for the person. Checks passed. Your review is next. is acceptable draft copy.
anatomy: Open/closed pull list, filters; pull tabs Conversation, Commits, Checks, Files changed; conversation timeline and right sidebar, per-file diffs and reviews. Stack is reachable from Pull requests, not a top-level repo tab.

purpose: What agents are doing and did
primary: Open the run that needs you
powers: Stage strip, flow graph, trace, needs-help and approvals inline; /approvals filters to waiting-on-you; resume after a closed tab; cost. Global Waiting on you inbox combines approvals asked of the person, Stack questions and reviews requested. The header inbox count equals the /approvals page count. /actions redirects to /runs.
anatomy: Runs occupy the Actions habit: filterable chronological list of status, flow, branch and timing; run detail has stages, progress, trace/logs and inline human decisions. Approvals and agents reachable here, not additional repo tabs.

powers: Run opens a form card. Flow source, graph, triggers and schedules (triggers.register), agents and models per role (/agents).
anatomy: Repository automation list and selected flow detail with overview, source, graph and run history; schedules/triggers beside their flow; role/model configuration accessible through agents.

powers: Provenance and revision per page; learning proposals from runs.
anatomy: Wiki home and rendered page, page navigation sidebar, title, edit/history actions and revisions. Proposals link their originating run and need a person's decision.

powers: Notes generated from landed changes; releases reachable from the Code home sidebar. /releases/latest redirects to the latest release, not the list or not-found.
anatomy: Releases list and tagged notes with version, author/date, linked tag/commit and assets where provided. No invented top-level Releases tab.

purpose: Run the factory for this repo
powers: Members, Secrets, Model connections (Claude or Codex subscription), Environment images, Sandboxes (egress, services), Triggers, Webhooks, GitHub sync, Reporting policy (reporting: off | signed-in). Secret values never appear in cards, logs or diagnostics. Hosted model connection held behind the install flag. Effect has no Ownership settings section or Ownership screens.
anatomy: Member-only Settings tab; section navigation in a left sidebar and labeled forms in the main pane; save is the one primary for the selected form.

powers: One box across all subjects.
anatomy: Search query box with q= in the URL, subject filters and relevant snippets linking directly to code, issues, runs and wiki pages.

powers: Context is the current view; answers render embedded; consequential acts confirm; every act has a slash form accepted by Ask. Ask is available on every repo view through the header and Command-K. Missing fields open exactly the needed form; signed-out guests respect caps.
anatomy: Ask docked right, open at 1440 px and wider, collapsed to the header Ask button at 1280 px, a bottom sheet at 390 px. Desktop content never narrows below 720 px; phone never scrolls sideways. A person's tab click maximizes that view with composer adjacent; an agent-opened view embeds in Ask. Messages, current-view context, Send and keyboard/close access. Ask is not a repo tab.

powers: Watched by the agent; SSH; branch sandbox states and linked run.
anatomy: Branch-specific terminal with command input/output, connection/sandbox status and SSH access; member-only hands-on sandbox, with truthful suspended and unavailable states.

powers: Docs appears only when declared. Effeck docs and source code have type hovers. Effect docs retain ?package= scope and link to package source. Effect Generate docs is cut; a remaining Generate docs control or screen is a failure, not missing required evidence.
anatomy: Docs index and page, navigation and source links; part of the shared repo frame, with truthful loading, error with Retry, empty, signed-out and denied acts.

powers: The declared Evals tab shows smthrs eval suites against baselines, per-case scores and reasons; running asks for input/confirmation and observes member/hosted boundaries.
anatomy: Suite list, suite detail, baseline comparison and case evidence; Evals follows Wiki and precedes Settings. No count on the declared tab. The suite list opens a suite; suite detail offers Run eval. A run-input form has its submission as primary; this does not require a Run eval button on every read-only list row.

powers: Golden set is the converter 20-case gate, held out of the prompt. Show inputs, expected output, actual results and reasons without fabricating a passed gate. Type hovers belong in docs and code.
anatomy: Declared Golden set tab after Wiki, before Settings; 20 cases and individual comparisons. A run requires a person and truthful held states. No count on the tab; it opens the golden-set suite directly, never a generic evals list.

powers: Package scope picker carried in ?package= across every tab, package list/detail with source, dependencies and docs; package changes preserve the shared repository UI. Scope is navigation, never authorization. Run affected and Check this package are cut; their controls and remaining screens are failures, never required acts or states. Ownership settings and Generate docs are also cut.
anatomy: Packages declared view and picker in the common frame; index opens a package, package detail browses its files, other tabs keep their spec-table primary. Observe scoped AND unscoped screens. Package scope is navigation only: no Run affected, Check this package, Generate docs or Ownership settings.

powers: Package scope is retained in ?package=. Matrix shows package/runtime results, skipped and missing states truthfully; failing cells link run logs.
anatomy: CI matrix under a run at GitHub-shaped repository paths; preserves shared frame, Runs tab and package scope.

purpose: Prepare package versions for a person
powers: Version packages uses changesets and shows the complete impact even when scoped; preview, confirmation, existing PR, stale, running, failed and held states. Only a person reviews and merges the version PR.
anatomy: Version packages at /releases/plan; shared frame and package picker, version preview followed by human confirmation. The initial plan primary is Preview release; a preview offers Prepare version PR, confirmation submits that act, and an existing PR offers Open version PR. Releases retains Open notes as its separate spec-table primary.

purpose: Inspect fixes with human acceptance and landing evidence
powers: The saved Fixed by agents view shows closed issues with agent fix evidence and human acceptance and landing receipts; it never claims that an agent approved or merged.
anatomy: Filtered issue list with evidence strip and direct issue links in the shared repository frame. This saved Issues list retains the Issues primary and access rules.
